title: Ultrasonic Sensor Awaaz Se Kaise Dekhta Hai? 🦇 #shorts
description:
Ye sensor awaaz se dekhta hai, aankhon se nahi! HC-SR04 bilkul chamgadad ki tarah echo se doori naapta hai.
🔊 Sensor 40 kHz ki ultrasonic awaaz bhejta hai
⏱️ Echo wapas aane ka time naapta hai
📏 Time se doori kaise nikalti hai, live dikhaya hai
🦇 Chamgadad andhere mein yehi trick use karte hain
